scientific_target: Distinguish bird identity from tag identity and evaluate whether independent barometric and GPS-quality channels can diagnose instrument artifacts underlying the opened DELTATRACK 2021 altitude shape signal.

parent_external_result.baseline: 40 birds, 899 bird-days, centered shape calibrated excess +0.073560 nats/event, Holm p=0.002

reference_source.prior_outcome_blind_metadata: 99 unique birds in 100 deployments; only one L. fuscus bird received different tags in 2020 and 2021, no two tags deployed within 2021 for that one bird.

policies.reuse_exact_source: 2021 GPS archive, no new year outcomes
policies.frozen_preprocessing: Same May-July UTC, valid horizontal coordinates, speed 5-55m/s, provider-marked outliers excluded, first eligible GPS event per individual UTC five-minute bin before altitude QC
policies.barometric_gate: At least 80% of native valid GPS altitude bins have finite paired barometric height and 10 birds each have >=2 UTC days with >=50 paired bins. Count nonzero and distinct barometric values separately; fail if constant placeholders are detected.
policies.tag_switch_gate: Report per-species IDs per tag and tags per animal within 2021. A cross-tag within-bird comparison needs >=2 independent tags for the same bird, each recorded on >=2 distinct days. Otherwise identity and instrument are inseparable from tag switch data.
policies.gps_metadata: Report missingness and quantiles of HDOP, satellite count, time-to-fix, and between-tag quality completeness; no outcome-dependent filtering.
policies.stationary_availability: For speed<=0.5m/s, report number of birds and bird-days with >=20 thinned fixes within May-July, using source-marked outlier rule. No spatial/elevation inference from stationary data at this gate.
policies.scientific_boundary: This is post-outcome measurement adequacy; it does not independently replicate biological identity, establish a causal mechanism, or rescue unavailable species.
